name: Greptile CLI
desc: Terminal command that runs a full Greptile review on your branch.
desc_zh: 在终端里对当前分支跑完整 Greptile 审查的命令。
solves: Waiting for a pull request to open before the review starts wastes a cycle; the same review runs locally before you push.
solves_zh: 等 Pull Request 建好才开始审查白跑一轮；同样的审查在推送前就能在本地跑。
best_for: You want review comments in the terminal before anyone else sees the branch.
best_for_zh: 想在别人看到这个分支之前，先在终端里拿到审查意见。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — greptile.com/changelog directory）。 Installed with npm i -g greptile. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.greptile.com/changelog
